package main

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"

	ahjs "clean.tech/solar/ahjs"
	contract "clean.tech/solar/ahjs/scenerycontract"
)

// SceneryNativeReloadIdentity is linked by the experiment builder. The plugin
// exports its own immutable inputs and generation; requests cannot substitute it.
var SceneryNativeReloadIdentity string

var service *ahjs.Service

const pluginReloadOperation = "ahjs/operation/list_ahjs"
const pluginReloadBinding = "ahjs/binding/list_ahjs_http"

type experimentDatabase struct{}

func (experimentDatabase) ExecContext(context.Context, string, ...any) (sql.Result, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("SQL is outside this feasibility experiment")
}
func (experimentDatabase) PrepareContext(context.Context, string) (*sql.Stmt, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("SQL is outside this feasibility experiment")
}
func (experimentDatabase) QueryContext(context.Context, string, ...any) (*sql.Rows, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("SQL is outside this feasibility experiment")
}
func (experimentDatabase) QueryRowContext(context.Context, string, ...any) *sql.Row {
	panic("unexpected SQL query in validation-only experiment")
}
func (experimentDatabase) BeginTx(context.Context, *sql.TxOptions) (*sql.Tx, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("SQL is outside this feasibility experiment")
}

// SceneryNativeReloadActivate constructs generation-scoped application state.
func SceneryNativeReloadActivate(fail bool) error {
	if service != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugin generation is already active")
	}
	input := contract.AhjsConstructorInput{}
	if !fail {
		input.Dependencies.Database = experimentDatabase{}
	}
	var err error
	service, err = ahjs.NewService(context.Background(), input)
	return err
}

// SceneryNativeReloadInvoke retains generated typed decode/outcome encoding.
func SceneryNativeReloadInvoke(operation, binding string, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	if service == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin generation is not active")
	}
	if operation != pluginReloadOperation || binding != pluginReloadBinding {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown operation or binding")
	}
	value, err := contract.UnmarshalListAhjsInput(input)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	outcome, err := service.ListVNext(context.Background(), value)
	if err != nil || outcome == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invoke AHJ implementation: %w", err)
	}
	return contract.MarshalListAhjsOutcome(outcome)
}
